world.title: Pakistan, Turkiye and Saudi deterrence against Houthis: What that means
world.summary: The Mecca pact between Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkiye is now active, following an emergency meeting in Riyadh. The agreement focuses on a defensive role for Islamabad while addressing the ongoing conflict in Yemen. The pact's implementation raises questions about Pakistan's ability to remain neutral as Riyadh's offensive against the Houthis continues to escalate.

world.title: US is watching Russia plague scare. Should India be on alert too?
world.summary: A suspected pneumonic plague case in Siberia has led to quarantine measures in Russia, prompting the US to monitor the situation closely. The article discusses the implications of this case, how pneumonic plague spreads, and raises questions about whether India, which experienced a significant outbreak in 1994, should be concerned about a potential resurgence of the disease.

world.title: Afghanistan opens a road link to China
world.summary: Afghanistan has established a new road link to China via the Wakhan Corridor in northeastern Badakhshan province. This corridor is a narrow strip of Afghan territory that connects to China, enhancing regional connectivity. The development is expected to facilitate trade and economic cooperation between the two countries, marking a significant step in Afghanistan's international relations.

business.title: Centre to propose five-pronged reform plan at GST Council meeting on October 8
business.summary: The Centre will present a five-pronged reform plan for the Goods and Services Tax (GST) at the GST Council meeting on October 8. The proposed reforms focus on process improvements, structural changes, enhancing ease of doing business, boosting services exports, and addressing e-commerce challenges. This initiative aims to streamline the GST system and promote economic growth.

business.title: Delhi High Court says PepsiCo, Monster can sell existing stocks of "energy drinks" but can't make more
business.summary: The Delhi High Court ruled that PepsiCo and Monster can sell their existing stocks of energy drinks but cannot produce more. This decision follows a directive from the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), which ordered the companies to remove the "energy drink" label and called for the seizure of their products, including Sting Energy and Monster Energy.

technology.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered boasts upgraded action and marginally better visuals
technology.summary: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt has received a significant update, enhancing its action and visuals in preparation for the upcoming Ciri-focused Witcher 4 and the bridging DLC, Songs of the Past. Polish developer CD Projekt Red aims to engage a new generation of players with this remastered version, building on the success of the original game released in 2015.

technology.title: Best EA FC 27 settings for shooting, defending and more
technology.summary: Optimizing settings in EA FC 27 can enhance gameplay by improving responsiveness and player control. Default configurations may not be ideal for all players. Pro players suggest specific tweaks for shooting, passing, defending, player switching, and camera angles to tailor the experience. Individual preferences and skill levels will influence the best settings for each player.

technology.title: GTA 5 Made Playable in Browser as AI-Generated Game Chaos Continues
technology.summary: Grand Theft Auto 5 became briefly playable in a web browser before being taken offline, coinciding with a surge of AI-generated games online. The gameplay footage circulated widely on social media, showcasing the game’s functionality in a browser environment. This development follows Bethesda's recent action to shut down Fallout: New York, highlighting ongoing trends in AI-driven gaming.

sports.title: 4 matches that laid bare the truth: Zidane has answers no one expected
sports.summary: Zinedine Zidane has started reshaping the French national team after four matches, achieving three wins and a draw, with seven goals scored and two conceded. He provided opportunities for most players to participate, resulting in a mix of winners and losers. This initial international camp has revealed surprises that could significantly alter the composition of Les Bleus moving forward.

sports.title: Green ruled out of series opener against Proteas
sports.summary: Cameron Green has been ruled out of the first Test against South Africa, as confirmed by Australia coach Andrew McDonald. Green sustained an abdominal injury while batting during the third ODI against South Africa last week. While he will not bowl in this series, there is a possibility he could return as a batter later on.

sports.title: India, Qatar among seven bidders as race to host 2036 Olympics takes shape
sports.summary: India and Qatar are among seven bidders confirmed by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) for hosting the 2036 Olympics. This announcement marks a significant advancement in India's efforts to secure the prestigious event. The competition includes various nations, highlighting the growing interest in hosting the Olympics. The final decision on the host city will be made in the coming years.

health.title: Can Creatine Supplements Help Build Muscles Even Without Exercise? What A New Study Says
health.summary: A 12-week study found that creatine supplements can enhance muscle and strength in middle-aged adults, even without exercise. Participants experienced significant gains in muscle and strength, which were further amplified when creatine was combined with a structured workout program and a calorie-reduced diet. The findings suggest creatine may be beneficial for muscle development regardless of physical activity levels.

health.title: From digestion to immunity, your gut may influence healthy ageing: Here are 7 things you need to know
health.summary: Research indicates that gut health significantly influences various aspects of healthy ageing, including digestion and immunity. Experts highlight seven key points about this connection, emphasizing the importance of maintaining a balanced gut microbiome. Factors such as diet, lifestyle, and probiotics may play crucial roles in promoting overall health and longevity, suggesting that gut health is vital for ageing well.

health.title: Could a personalised flu warning get more people vaccinated? US study says yes
health.summary: A study involving approximately 90,000 US patients found that personalized risk messages encouraging high-risk individuals to get vaccinated against influenza resulted in a small yet measurable increase in vaccination rates. Researchers utilized an AI tool to identify patients at higher risk of flu. The findings suggest that tailored reminders may be more effective than generic or no messages.

science.title: Nobel physics prize awarded for detection of cosmic neutrinos
science.summary: Belgian physicist Francis Halzen has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for his contributions to neutrino detection at a South Pole observatory. His research has advanced the understanding of high-energy neutrinos, which originate from deep space, helping to unlock various mysteries of the Universe. Halzen's work represents a significant achievement in astrophysics and particle physics.

science.title: Scientists studying ancient Siberian bone fragments used DNA to identify a previously unknown extinct bovine related to modern yaks that followed its own evolutionary path for hundreds of thousands of
science.summary: Scientists have identified a previously unknown extinct bovine related to modern yaks, based on DNA analysis of ancient bone fragments from southern Siberia. These fragments, once considered unremarkable, revealed a distinct evolutionary lineage that diverged from other bovines for hundreds of thousands of years. The findings enhance understanding of bovine evolution and biodiversity in ancient ecosystems.

science.title: Mars's polar ice is not as dusty as we thought
science.summary: Mars's north polar ice has been found to be less dusty than earlier estimates suggested. This discovery may change scientists' understanding of the planet's climate history and its potential for past habitability. Researchers Khuller and Mohan identified inaccuracies in previous methods that relied on lunar regolith, opting for a more reliable approach to assess the ice's properties.

entertainment.title: "There Was Only One Love": Vijay's Son Jason Sanjay Reveals He Was In A Relationship For 1.5 Years
entertainment.summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay's son, Jason Sanjay, revealed he was in a 1.5-year relationship that ended mutually. He stated, "We both talked to each other and broke up." Jason recently made his directorial debut with the film Sigma, which earned Rs 6.19 crore in its first Monday and a total gross collection of Rs 7.04 crore in India.

entertainment.title: Sonakshi Sinha, Shahid Kapoor’s driver Suraj Lama started momo restaurant with wife, who worked as late singer KK’s cook, FDA and Tukaram Mundhe shut it down
entertainment.summary: Suraj Lama, a former driver for Bollywood stars including Shahid Kapoor, has launched a momo restaurant in Mumbai with his wife, who previously cooked for late singer KK. However, the establishment was shut down by the FDA and Tukaram Mundhe due to unspecified reasons. The venture highlights an intriguing connection between the city’s culinary scene and Bollywood.

entertainment.title: Anupam Kher ‘almost slapped me’ over hospital costs: Raju Kher on battling bladder cancer
entertainment.summary: Raju Kher, diagnosed with bladder cancer in 2004, recounted how his brother Anupam Kher returned from a shoot abroad to support him. Raju revealed that Anupam quietly covered all treatment costs without his knowledge, describing him as a father figure. Raju expressed gratitude for Anupam's numerous acts of kindness during his battle with cancer.
